mainEntity.name: How many days is the fertile window?

acceptedAnswer.text: About six days: the five days before ovulation and the day of ovulation. The chance of conception is highest on the two days before ovulation and on ovulation day itself.

mainEntity.name: Does ovulation always happen on day 14?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Day 14 applies only to a 28-day cycle with a 14-day luteal phase. With a 32-day cycle, ovulation is more likely around day 18, and timing can shift from cycle to cycle.

Ovulation predictor kits detect the hormone surge 1–2 days before ovulation, and a sustained rise in basal body temperature confirms it has happened. Tracking over several cycles also shows your personal pattern.
